title: Give Thanks
lyrics_original: Give thanks with a grateful heart
Give thanks to the holy one
And now let the weak say I am strong
Let the poor say I am rich.
Because of what The Lord has done for us (2)      || Give Thanks ||

bible_verses.telugu: ప్రతి విషయమునందును కృతజ్ఞతాస్తుతులు చెల్లించుడి. ఈలాగు చేయుట యేసుక్రీస్తునందు మీ విషయములో దేవుని చిత్తము.
bible_verses.english: give thanks in all circumstances; for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.

bible_verses.telugu: అందుకునా కృప నీకు చాలును, బలహీనతయందు నాశక్తి పరిపూర్ణమగుచున్నదని ఆయన నాతో చెప్పెను. కాగా క్రీస్తు శక్తి నామీద నిలిచియుండు నిమిత్తము, విశేషముగా నా బలహీనతలయందె
bible_verses.english: But he said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Therefore I will boast all the more gladly about my weaknesses, so that Christ’s power may rest on me.

bible_verses.telugu: మీరు మన ప్రభువైన యేసుక్రీస్తు కృపను ఎరుగుదురుగదా? ఆయన ధన వంతుడై యుండియు మీరు తన దారిద్ర్యమువలన ధనవంతులు కావలెనని, మీ నిమిత్తము దరిద్రుడాయెను.
bible_verses.english: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sake he became poor, so that you through his poverty might become rich.

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, thank You for the priceless gift of Your Son, Jesus Christ. When I feel weak or lacking, remind me that my identity and strength are anchored in Your grace. Teach me to cultivate a heart of gratitude in every circumstance, trusting in what You have done for me. Fill my spirit with peace today as I fix my eyes on Your goodness. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Heavenly Father, thank You for the priceless gift of Your Son, Jesus Christ. devotional.reflection_english: True gratitude begins when we look at the gift of Jesus Christ. When life feels overwhelming or our strength runs thin, this song gently reminds us that our true wealth and power are found in what God has already given us. In Christ, our weakness becomes a place for His strength to shine, and our spiritual poverty is filled with His limitless grace. Today, take a quiet moment to turn your heart upward, giving thanks not because everything is perfect, but because He is faithful.
